meta.strategy: Social Proof based on Brand Voice

content.headline: The Pulse of African Progress
content.subhead: Join the visionary leaders transforming mobility and sustainability across the continent.

testimonials.name: Amara Okafor
testimonials.title: Chief Operations Officer
testimonials.quote: Bluetone's autonomous fleet has transformed our city's logistics, proving that smart tech can adapt to local streets seamlessly and safely.
testimonials.image_prompt: A professional portrait of a West African woman in her late 40s, COO attire, soft bokeh city background, warm lighting, high-end photography style, shot on 85mm lens.

testimonials.name: Kwame Mensah
testimonials.title: Director of Sustainability
testimonials.quote: Integrating Bluetone vehicles wasn't just a tech upgrade; it was a commitment to a cleaner, faster future for our community's next generation.
testimonials.image_prompt: A sharp, professional headshot of a Ghanaian man in a modern blazer, smiling confidently, bright natural daylight, corporate office terrace background, ultra-realistic.

testimonials.name: Dr. Zanele Mbeki
testimonials.title: Logistics Consultant
testimonials.quote: Their law-abiding robots are a masterclass in navigating complex regulatory environments while maintaining peak operational efficiency.
testimonials.image_prompt: A sophisticated portrait of a South African woman, academic and professional aesthetic, wearing glasses, soft studio lighting, neutral background, 8k resolution.

testimonials.name: David Otieno
testimonials.title: Founder
testimonials.quote: Reliability meets innovation. Bluetone is the first partner to truly understand the infrastructure needs and cultural nuances of the continent.
testimonials.image_prompt: A professional portrait of an East African male executive, tech-entrepreneur style, light blue shirt, blurred modern architectural background, high contrast, cinematic depth of field.
